summary: Add inactive delegated keeper validation and death watcher (unit 7b)

rules.detail: Admission is not wired. Keeper ensure and watcher have no startup or scheduler caller. Explicit heavy slice and memory/pids controllers required; io enabled when available.

compatibility.detail: Agent Policy approved a host/class delegated keeper with its own process in idle, sibling to every J. Empty idle is repaired in the same scope, without job relaunch. Fake-tree fixtures cover reuse, validation, keeper death, job sampling and typed counters-unavailable. B6 path/dedication guards reject extra PIDs, populated children and subtree controllers.

manual.detail: No defaults, activation or deployment changes. J is sampled promptly on exit then removed; no sentinel or per-job transient unit.

recovery.detail: Unit 8 owns uncertain-launch fencing. Missing counters never become zero or authorize rerun.
